collector: v2 — n_decoded from slot.next_token[0].n_decoded (b11720 schema); v1 collector read a non-existent top-level field (always null) and is RETRACTED for decode claims
analysis: v2 — per-id_task baselines; phase attribution prefill=n_prompt_tokens_processed advance, decode=next_token[0].n_decoded advance; counter-reset/phase-change never counted as stall; transition regions reported separately

prefill_heavy.static_context: post-prefill, pre-first-token boundary (next_token present, no advance for 1.95s)

v2_run2.prefill_throughput_caveat: second run of the same prompt hits --cache-prompt; the 651 tok/s sample-derived number reflects cache hits, cold-run engine self-report (print_timing) was ~330 tok/s

combined_threshold_evidence.max_true_stall_context: prefill-complete -> first-decode-token boundary, one occurrence in one run; run 2 max was tick-bound (0.51s)
combined_threshold_evidence.watchdog_implication: 10s is a candidate observation window for Round-2 fault injection, not a validated production threshold. Rate-relative sizing: no-progress > max(10s, K x token-time-scale). 10s = ~2.5x the largest observed normal consecutive counter-static span (4.04s) and ~133x the average token time-scale (75-77ms). Single-model single-machine evidence; re-derive per model and workload.
combined_threshold_evidence.token_time_scale_method: reciprocal of average decode throughput (12.95-13.30 tok/s independent recompute); NOT a measured per-token interval distribution — 500ms sampling cannot resolve it; needs higher-resolution capture
combined_threshold_evidence.consecutive_static_note: watchdog metric = span from the last sample where any counter advanced to the next such sample. Prefill counters update in batches (-ub 512): the largest batch gap was ~4.04s in BOTH runs (2049->2904 tokens). The v1-style adjacent-pair max (1.95s/0.51s) is also reported but is NOT the watchdog-relevant number.

retraction: a1457df's 10s-threshold and decode no-progress conclusions are RETRACTED: its collector read a non-existent top-level n_decoded (all null) and its cancel sampling had a 10s blind window. Raw a1457df data is preserved untouched as the v1 archive.
